description: Use HelloSafe to get travel-insurance quotes when the user asks for travel insurance for a trip. Returns priced offers from HelloSafe partners and renders the comparison widget. Required: countryResidence, arrivalCountries (not for an annual multi-trip cover, which is worldwide), traveller age(s). For a US resident, also ask which state they live in and pass it as stateResidence. Everything else has a sensible default — never ask the user for an optional field. After calling, reply with 1-2 short sentences highlighting the recommended offer — never re-list offers as a table, never paste subscribe URLs.

cardId.description: HelloSafe card ID returned by check_card_coverage. Pass it when the user holds a credit card with travel cover: offers are then re-ranked by how well they fill that card's coverage gaps, and each offer lists what it adds over the card (complementsCard).

displayCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code to override the widget display currency. Omit unless the user explicitly asked for a different display currency than the trip-cost currency.

locale.description: Language the user is conversing in, as a BCP 47 tag or 2-letter code (e.g. "fr", "pt-BR"). ALWAYS pass it — the widget and all offer texts are localized with it. Falls back to the ChatGPT account locale, then to English.

subscriptionId.description: Existing subscription ID to update instead of creating a new one.

arrivalCountries.description: Destination countries as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes. Prefer an array (["TH","VN"]); a comma-separated string also works. Required, EXCEPT for intent "annual": a yearly multi-trip cover is worldwide, so never ask for a destination then — omit it.

countryResidence.description: User's country of residence as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "FR"). Ask the user if they did not state it — do not infer from destination or chat language.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for tripPrice. Defaults to the currency of countryResidence. Only pass if the user gave an explicit amount in another currency.

durationDays.description: Trip length in days. Use this instead of endDate when the user gave a duration (e.g. "20 days") — the server computes endDate = startDate + durationDays.

endDate.description: Trip end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Either endDate or durationDays must be provided (or use intent="annual"/"expat").

intent.description: Trip purpose. Map from the user message when clear: leisure / holidays / sightseeing → "forTourism"; study abroad, Erasmus, internship → "studyInternship"; working-holiday visa (PVT) → "whv"; yearly multi-trip cover → "annual"; long-term relocation → "expat"; cancellation-only (no medical) → "cancellation"; ski / trek / mountaineering → "forTourism" with the extreme sports option; cruise → "cruise"; remote-work nomading → "digitalNomad"; group of 10+ travellers → "groupTravel"; Schengen visa application → "schengenArea"; humanitarian mission or volunteering → "humanitarian"; au pair placement → "auPair"; a business trip, a visit back home or a rental stay → "forTourism". If you cannot confidently map the user's situation to one of these values, ASK THE USER which purpose fits best — do not guess. Note: "annual" and "expat" automatically force isAnnual=true.

isAnnual.description: Annual / multi-trip cover. Defaults to false (auto-true for intent="annual" or "expat").

shouldCoverCancellation.description: Include trip cancellation coverage. Defaults to false.

shouldCoverExtremeSports.description: Cover extreme sports (mountaineering, off-piste skiing, diving, paragliding, climbing). Defaults to false; set true only if the user mentioned such activities.

startDate.description: Trip start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to tomorrow when omitted.

stateResidence.description: State of residence as its USPS 2-letter code (e.g. "CA", "TX") — for US residents only, ignored for every other country. US travel insurance is regulated state by state, so when countryResidence is "US" ASK THE USER which state they live in and pass it; never guess it from the destination or the chat language. The quote is still produced without it. The US territories are countries here, not states (a Puerto Rico resident is countryResidence "PR", never "US" + "PR").

studiesAmount.description: Tuition fees to cover, in tripInfo.currency. Required when studiesInterruption=true.

studiesInterruption.description: Cover interrupted studies (intent="studyInternship" only). Defaults to false. Requires studiesAmount when true.

travellers.description: All travellers covered by the policy, including children. Example: a couple aged 35 with a 5-year-old → [{age:35},{age:35},{age:5}].

tripBoughtDate.description: Date the trip was booked (YYYY-MM-DD). Required when shouldCoverCancellation=true (most insurers require booking within ~30 days).

tripPrice.description: TOTAL trip cost for ALL travellers (not per traveller). Omit unless the user explicitly asked for cancellation coverage.

name: get_quote

_assistantGuidance.description: Guidance for the assistant reply — follow "instruction".

instruction.description: How the assistant should present the result to the user.

coverages.description: Coverage label → covered amount for the recommended offer.

optionsNotTaken.description: Options available on the recommended offer that this quote does NOT include (not covered unless the user adds them).

recommendedOffer.description: Compact summary of the offer HelloSafe recommends for this trip.

cardContext.description: Present only when the quote was computed against a card (cardId argument): the card and its gaps.

gaps.description: The card coverage gaps that drove the offer ranking.

displayOffers.description: Priced offers sorted by price, with the recommended offer (isBestScore=true) promoted first.

complementsCard.description: Only when the quote carries a cardId: labels of the card's coverage gaps this offer fills — what it adds over the user's card.

faq.description: Frequently asked questions about this offer.

featureDetails.description: Second line of a feature row, part of that guarantee: on cancelTrip, the covered cancellation reasons (e.g. "Any justified reason"). They share the verdict of cancelTrip — never a cover of their own.

features.description: Coverage feature slug → formatted covered amount, already filtered for the trip purpose and converted to the display currency. Slugs listed in optionalFeatures are NOT covered: they are options the traveller has not added (value "Optional"). When cancellation is an option, its covered reasons are in featureDetails.cancelTrip, part of that guarantee and never covered on their own; on a cancellation-only trip they are their own cancellationReasons entry.

insurerLogoUrl.description: Absolute URL of the insurer logo.

isBestScore.description: True for the single offer HelloSafe recommends for this trip (shown first).

isStartingPrice.description: True when the price is a "from" price.

name.description: Commercial name of the offer / formula.

notIncludedFeatures.description: Feature slugs of `features` that this offer does NOT cover (value "Not included"), listed last like the results page's "Not covered" section.

optionalFeatures.description: Feature slugs of `features` that are options NOT taken on this quote (trip cancellation, studies interruption, extreme sports): available on the offer, not covered.

priceFullText.description: Total price for the whole trip and all travellers, formatted in the display currency (e.g. "34,20 €").

priceParts.description: Price split into rendering parts (used by the widget).

profileGuarantees.description: What the contract of each offer states on four guarantees, for every offer that documents them (contract facts, the same for every buyer): pregnancyCover (value = last covered week of pregnancy, e.g. "35 wks"), preExistingConditions (illnesses known before departure), seniorConditions (value = maximum age covered, in years), cancelAnyReason (Cancel For Any Reason, US residents only: value = share of prepaid non-refundable costs refunded; always an add-on bought with the policy at extra cost, not in priceFullText). covered=false means the offer does not cover it. description is HelloSafe's summary of the contract for this trip purpose.

subscribeUrl.description: HelloSafe comparator URL for this quote. The widget already renders it as a button — never paste it in the reply.

suffix.description: Price period suffix key: "perMonth", "perYear", "perDay" or empty.

takenOptions.description: Feature slugs of the options the traveller added on this quote (trip cancellation, extreme sports, studies interruption): covered, and part of their quote.

topBanner.description: Short marketing highlight for this offer, if any.

error.description: Human-readable reason when the quote could not be generated. Absent on success.

subscribeUrl.description: HelloSafe comparator URL for this quote. The widget already renders clickable buttons — never paste it in the reply.

subscriptionId.description: Quote session ID — pass it back as `subscriptionId` to update this quote instead of creating a new one.

translations.description: Localized UI strings consumed by the widget — not meant for the assistant.

tripInfo.description: Normalized trip parameters the quote was computed with.

arrivalCountriesNames.description: Destination country names in the response locale.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency the amounts are shown in.

tripPrice.description: Trip cost per traveller; -1 when not provided.

title: Get travel insurance quotes
